reason: I'd play with the free tricks, maybe even use one at Friday dinner, but I'm not typing my card into some website for an app that isn't even in the App Store. If it's real and good, why isn't it on Google Play or the App Store?
objection: Paying on an unknown website with my card feels risky, and an app installed from the browser instead of the store makes me wonder who's behind it and whether it'll still work next year.
would_change_my_mind: If I could buy it through the App Store or Google Play, or pay with PayPal/Bit so my card never touches their site.
